rows.detail: 'responds to clarification requests 1 to 6', but ADD-01/Q4 adds an obligation (ADD-01:Q4): 'The geotechnical report in the data room is provided for information. Bidders shall satisfy themselves as to ground conditions.'

ADD-01/3.1 adds an obligation (ADD-01:3.1); the summary does not mention it: 'The attendance record is held by the Authority. A Bidder that considers its attendance to have been incorrectly recorded shall notify the Authority through the Portal within five (5) Working Days of this Addendum.'
ADD-01/AppA/para1 replaces VOL-IV:F4-A; the summary does not mention it: 'Form 4-A is reissued below to add the acknowledgement of Addenda at paragraph 1. Bidders shall use this version.'
ADD-02:7.2 states 'Failure to submit Form 4-G shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'adds Form 4-G'

'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6', but ADD-02/9.1 reinstates it in an amended form: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty-five per cent (35%) for the construction phase. Failure …' (as issued: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty per cent (30%) f…')
ADD-02:9.1 states 'Failure to submit the certificate shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6'

ADD-02/T1-1-rev/note(2) amends VOL-I:11.2; the summary does not mention it: '(2) The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial.'
ADD-02/5.2 adds an obligation (VOL-II:S3); the summary does not mention it: 'Bidders shall reflect the amended limit in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.'
ADD-02/9.2 ends the effect of ADD-01:4.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Section 4.2 of Addendum No. 1 ceases to have effect.'
'replaces the fourth declaration in Form 4-C': no provision of ADD-03 does this
'amends Volume II Table 2-4': no provision of ADD-03 does this
'reissues Form 4-G' describes ADD-03/AppA/para1, which is INVALID and was not applied (C22: the provision cites no clause, table, form or section that exists in the pack)

ADD-03/6.1 amends VOL-V:29.3; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume V Clause 29.3, ‘ninety per cent (90%)’ is deleted and ‘eighty-five per cent (85%)’ is substituted. The duration of the Ramp-Up Period is unchanged.'
